newsitem.title: USA: MVSI acquires Expert Inc for 300,000 shrs.
newsitem.headline: MVSI acquires Expert Inc for 300,000 shrs.

text.p: MVSI Inc said Monday that it has completed the acquisition of Expert Inc, a maker of proprietary and generic computer systems products and services, for 300,000 shares of stock.
The shares are newly-issued, and MVSI said they may not be sold for at least one year from the date of issuance.
The company also said it intends to contine to grow its business through acquisitions or mergers.

MVSI manufactures and integrates machine vision systems for the robotics, semiconductor and welding industries, integrates and markets name brand proprietary and generic high-end computer system products and support services, and distributes computer memory products in modular form for integration by manufacturers of computers, plotters, laser printers and other process controllers.
